name: Magellan Health
one_liner: Manages mental health and substance use benefits for some health plans, employers and government programs; you use it through your plan.
best_for: People whose health plan, employer or government program uses Magellan for behavioral health
Members who need help finding an in-network therapist or psychiatrist
Families in programs Magellan manages, such as foster care, autism or military services
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People whose plan does not use Magellan
People looking for a therapy app they can sign up for and pay for directly
short_description: A behavioral health benefits manager: if your plan uses Magellan, it runs the network of therapists and psychiatrists you can see and coordinates care.
long_description: Magellan Health manages behavioral health services on behalf of health plans, employers and government agencies, including programs for foster children, autism care, crisis services, behavioral health prescribing, high-acuity care, and services for active-duty military and federal agencies. It is not something you buy yourself: if your plan or employer contracts with Magellan, you use its provider network and member services to find and get approval for mental health and substance use care, and your costs are set by your plan. Centene bought Magellan in 2022; in February 2026 Madison Health Group announced a deal to buy Magellan from Centene, pending regulatory approval, and said it would continue these programs. Magellan coordinates care delivered by licensed clinicians; we found no published study of Magellan's own services.

pricing.starting_price: Through your health plan or employer; your plan's copays apply
pricing.notes: Magellan manages benefits for plans, employers and government programs; it does not sell services directly to individuals. Costs depend on your plan.

privacy.notes: We could not open Magellan's privacy policy or notice of privacy practices for this review, so its data practices are unverified.

seo.meta_description: Magellan Health manages behavioral health benefits for insurance plans and employers, connecting members with in-network mental health providers.

faqs.a: No, Magellan manages behavioral health benefits—they maintain networks of providers, authorize treatment, and coordinate care. The actual therapy comes from in-network clinicians. Think of Magellan as the organization behind your mental health insurance benefits.

faqs.q: How do I find a therapist through Magellan?
faqs.a: Contact Magellan member services (phone number on your insurance card) or use their online provider directory. They can help you find in-network therapists and psychiatrists in your area. Prior authorization may be required for some services.

Yes, many employers contract with Magellan for EAP (Employee Assistance Program). This provides free confidential counseling sessions, work-life resources, and crisis support. Check with your HR department to see if Magellan manages your EAP.

faqs.q: What specialty programs does Magellan offer?
faqs.a: Magellan offers specialty care management for autism spectrum disorder, eating disorders, substance use treatment, and complex behavioral health conditions. These programs provide additional coordination and support beyond standard benefits.

primary_uses: Approval and coordination of mental health and substance use care
Crisis and high-acuity behavioral health programs
Autism and foster care programs run for states and plans
Behavioral health services for military and federal agencies

patient_summary: If your health plan, employer or a government program uses Magellan, you use it to find in-network therapists and psychiatrists and to get care approved and coordinated. You don't sign up or pay Magellan directly; your plan's copays and deductibles apply. Check your insurance card or benefits materials to see whether Magellan manages your behavioral health coverage.

availability.note: Only for members of health plans, employers and government programs that contract with Magellan. Sale from Centene to Madison Health Group announced February 2026, pending approval.
